item.title: Cavan senator on need for cost of disability payments
item.description: A Cavan Senator has spoken out on the costs of disability and the lack of support in budget 2026. Pauline Tully spoke in the Seanad today about how she attended a protest held yesterday outside Leinster House, which was highlighting the issue. She noted, people with disabilities, their advocates and carers have been advocating for a cost of disability payment for years, which she said was promised before the last election. item.description: The chairperson of Cavan/Monaghan Fine Gael has resigned. item.title: Local reaction to measures to protect children online
item.description: A local senator is welcoming the introduction of further measures to protect young people online. Senator Joe O'Reilly said new steps are being taken to introduce age verification to better protect children in Cavan online. He said that parents are doing their part in trying to protect their children from online dangers like pornography, cyberbullying and harmful algorithms that can lead to exploitation. item.title: Tendering process underway on Kingscourt regeneration works
item.description: A local councillor has welcomed the news that the tendering process of regeneration works in Kingscourt is set to get underway. The town centre regeneration project is set to transform Main Street, Kingscourt along with the former builders merchants yard. Also included are plans for a new town library and a digital hub along with over 100 off-street parking spaces. item.title: End of an era as the Northern Standard to cease operations
item.description: After almost 200 years in operation, the Northern Standard have announced today that they will cease operations. The Northern Standard has been the longest established newspaper circulating in County Monaghan and it has been telling Monaghan's story every week since the first issue was published back in January 10th, 1839.
